research.reason: The research workbench (registry, frozen snapshots, runs) is enabled on this deployment. A missing research backup is a failure, never a skip. Only an explicit NOT_REQUIRED here allows SKIPPED.

required.registry: research/registry.sqlite3 (online backup, quick_check ok, every table digested)
per_succeeded_run: ledger_cost<bps>bps.csv for every cost in the run's config
required.per_succeeded_run_v2: every artifact registered for the run in the artifacts table (size and SHA-256 must match the registry)
required.per_registered_dataset_note: bundle datasets: files listed in their manifest (market_research.sqlite, manifest.json)

research.restore_check: verify --run RUN_ID re-executes exactly that run (new id, attempt_of) in an image that supports its engine; v2 deterministic artifacts compared byte-for-byte; other runs hash-checked; no other QUEUED run is claimed

news.reason: news/news_v1.sqlite3 (items, versions, tombstones, provider_state) sits on personal_var and is copied by quant_sqlite_backup.py (rglob *.sqlite3, online backup + quick_check). Rights register configs/quant_news_sources_v1.json ships with the code. Provider keys live in /srv/quant/secrets/news.env and are never in backups or handoffs.
